newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Azomures takes Bucharest bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Azomures takes Bucharest bourse higher.

text.p: Heavy trading in Azomures SA fertiliser maker kept Bucharest bourse turnover high on Tuesday at 806.5 million lei, slightly up from the previous session.
Two independent indices drifted to year highs.
"The 'Azomania' continued today, with more than 90 percent of Azomures trades in cross deals, as well as a special trade," said a broker.

Cross deals -- allowing a broker to act for both the buyer and the seller of a security in the same deal -- were introduced two weeks ago and brokers welcomed the move expecting it to boost turnover. Tuesday's level was double that of two weeks ago.
Azomures had a "special trade" -- a deal outside the market reported to the bourse later -- involving some 5,000 shares on turnover of 135 million lei.
The fertiliser maker, the sole stock on the bourse's first tier, closed a strong 3,200 lei higher at 27,200.
Oil drilling company Foraj Sonde SA and carbide maker Carbid-Fox SA traded more shares than Azomures, but their turnover levels were smaller due to their lower prices.
"How can you not buy a stock that is worth less than a bus ticket?" said a trader in reference to Foraj's closing price of 272 lei, a little more than half Bucharest bus fares.
Carbid-Fox, which took 39.3 million lei in turnover, closed 80 lei higher at 1,290.
Investors also focused on Artrom SA engineering company, which had a turnover of 50 million lei and closed 300 lei weaker at 3,050.
Three stocks had no trade and Sanevit SA syringe maker, suspended last November, remained halted from trading pending an announcement on its new capital base.
Two unofficial indices - the VAB and the BIG -- rose by 4.6 percent and 4.56 percent respectively on the previous session.
